ars_n_spells.ritual_desc.spell_transcrip: Inscribes a cross-mod spell onto a blank target item. Drop a filled Ars Nouveau spell parchment, focus, or spellbook (or an Iron's Spellbooks scroll) as the source, and a blank target item within three blocks of the brazier. Right-click the inscribed item to cast the spell; sneak-right-click cycles between multiple inscriptions.
ars_n_spells.ritual_desc.mana_infusion: Grants a one-off burst of mana to the nearest player when the ritual completes. The amount is server-configurable (ritual_mana_infusion_amount, 500 by default) and is paid into whichever pool the current mana unification mode treats as primary.
ars_n_spells.ritual_desc.mana_well: Regenerates mana for every player within range for as long as the ritual runs. Radius and rate are server-configurable (mana_well_range, mana_well_regen_rate) and the mana is paid into whichever pool the current mana unification mode treats as primary.

ars_n_spells.ritual_desc.spellbook_bindi: Binds an Ars spell carried by a real Iron's Spellbooks scroll onto a real Iron's spell book. This is one of two routes: a carrier scroll can also be bound at an Iron's Inscription Table. For the ritual, drop exactly one carrier scroll (woven at the Spell Loom, or exported with /ans export_to_irons_scroll) and exactly one spell book within three blocks of the brazier, with nothing else in range — any other dropped item aborts the ritual. Light the brazier by right-clicking it with an empty hand. The scroll is consumed and the bound spell appears as its own entry in Iron's native spell wheel.

ars_n_spells.book.title: Ars 'n' Spells
ars_n_spells.book.description: Carry your spells between Ars Nouveau and Iron's Spellbooks. Learn inscription, resource rules, and safe removal.
ars_n_spells.book.loom.name: Spell Loom
ars_n_spells.book.loom.1: Select a valid Ars spell in a spellbook, then place the book in the Loom source slot and a blank Iron's scroll in the target slot. Choose a name and a School (next page). Choose icon sets the cosmetic icon and background. Inscription makes one carrier scroll and preserves a reusable book or focus. A disposable Ars parchment costs one unit.
ars_n_spells.book.loom.2: A filled Iron's scroll is already a spell. Ordinary inscription refuses it. Use the explicit Convert action only when you want to replace the spell on one target scroll. Empty the output before the next operation. Rejected actions move no items. Hoppers insert source from above, targets from the sides, and extract output below.
ars_n_spells.book.transcription.name: Spell Transcription
ars_n_spells.book.transcription.1: Create this tablet in the Enchanting Apparatus. Crafting the tablet consumes its recipe ingredients. To use it, place exactly one readable spell source and one suitable empty target within three blocks of the brazier. Insert the tablet and activate the brazier with an empty main hand. Extra candidates are refused.
ars_n_spells.book.transcription.2: One disposable source unit produces one target unit. A reusable spellbook or focus stays intact. A filled native Iron's scroll can be a source and costs one scroll; it is never silently treated as a blank target. Leftover target units retain their original data. Failed transcription preserves the input stacks.
ars_n_spells.book.binding.name: Spellbook Binding
ars_n_spells.book.binding.1: Export an Ars spell to an Iron's carrier scroll with the Loom. For the binding ritual, place exactly one carrier and one compatible Iron's book within three blocks of the brazier. Insert the tablet and activate with an empty main hand. Success consumes one carrier and adds its Ars spell to the book's native wheel.
ars_n_spells.book.binding.2: Existing native spells, upgrades, and names stay on the book. The carrier's custom name, icon and school travel with its spell. The default pool allows eight Ars entries; a server can set a smaller cap or disable new binding. A spell the book already holds with the same school is a duplicate: a different name, background or icon does not count, a different school does. Duplicates and full books are refused without consuming inputs.
ars_n_spells.book.unbind.name: Spell Uninscription
ars_n_spells.book.unbind.1: Place one inscribed item near the brazier and run this ritual to remove all of its ANS inscriptions and proxy wheel slots. Unrelated native spells and item data remain. A custom or anvil name is retained. Do not add extra source or target items: ambiguous candidates are refused.
ars_n_spells.book.unbind.2: For books bound in 3.3.0, empty ANS-added tail slots are restored to the recorded original capacity. Later native spells above that capacity remain. An older book without a recorded baseline keeps surplus empty slots. Back up your world before removing upstream content or dimension mods.
ars_n_spells.book.rules.name: Mana and Schools
ars_n_spells.book.rules.1: The server chooses the paying mana pool. iss_primary and hybrid use Iron's; ars_primary uses Ars. separate can split cross-cast costs between both pools, while disabled uses native costs. Inscribed cross-casts have 25% overhead by default. Read a refusal message before retrying: the server validates held items and payment.
ars_n_spells.book.rules.2: Payload effects determine schools; filters and augments do not become elemental payloads. Custom school namespaces remain distinct. Use /ans journal to inspect your school levels, counts, and applied progression. /ans diagnose reports versions, routing, and the server mapping digest. /ans removal_report is a read-only inventory report, not a complete world scan.

ars_n_spells.glyph_press.help.1: Inscribe Glyph turns one filled Iron's scroll into the Ars glyph for that exact spell and level. It uses the scroll, one blank glyph plate, the tier's Source gems and Source from nearby jars. Nothing is consumed until the glyph is finished.
ars_n_spells.glyph_press.help.2: The glyph is knowledge, not a charge: use it the normal Ars way to learn it, then add it to spells like any glyph. Each level is its own glyph.
ars_n_spells.glyph_press.help.3: This is not the Spell Loom's export, which writes an Ars spell onto a scroll, and not a ritual. The Press only reads a scroll; it never writes one.
ars_n_spells.glyph_press.help.4: Hoppers may supply scrolls from above, plates and gems from the sides, and take glyphs from below. A running job locks its inputs; Cancel returns them and its Source.

ars_n_spells.book.glyph_press.name: Glyph Press
ars_n_spells.book.glyph_press.1: The Glyph Press turns a filled Iron's scroll into a real Ars glyph for that spell at that level. Put the scroll in the cradle slot, a blank glyph plate below it, Source gems beside the plate, and keep Source jars within a few blocks. Then press Inscribe Glyph.
ars_n_spells.book.glyph_press.2: Nothing is consumed until the glyph is finished. A job locks its inputs; Cancel returns them and the Source. Higher tiers need more: tier I takes 1 gem and 500 Source, tier II 2 and 1,500, tier III 4 and 3,000. A server may change these.
ars_n_spells.book.glyph_press.3: The result is knowledge: use the glyph to learn it, then add it to spells like any glyph. Each level is a separate glyph. Spells Iron's makes you learn must be learned there first. This is not the Spell Loom's export and not a ritual.
ars_n_spells.book.glyph_press.example: A level 1 Firebolt scroll, a blank glyph plate, 1 Source gem and 500 Source make the Firebolt I glyph in five seconds.
ars_n_spells.book.imported_glyphs.name: Iron's Glyphs
ars_n_spells.book.imported_glyphs.1: An Iron's glyph casts its Iron's spell inside an Ars spell, at the glyph's level. The form decides the target: Self casts on you, Touch on what you touch, Projectile where it lands, Underfoot below you. Some spells work only with Self; the spell book says which.
ars_n_spells.book.imported_glyphs.2: Amplify and Dampen raise or lower the cast level within the spell's range. The Iron's mana cost joins the Ars spell's cost and is paid once, under the server's mana rules. Iron's cooldowns apply per spell, shared by all its levels.
ars_n_spells.book.imported_glyphs.3: Charged and channelled spells hold the rest of the Ars spell until they finish. If Iron's is removed or the server disables a spell, its glyph stays in your books as a dormant glyph that does nothing, and works again when restored.
